source_caption:
Christopher Nolan was reportedly initially attached to direct 𝐓𝐫𝐨𝐲 (𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟒), but after Wolfgang Petersen’s ‘Batman vs. Superman’ was canceled, the project changed course and Petersen took over as director.⁣⁣
⁣⁣
In a serendipitous turn of events, once Nolan stepped away, he was offered to direct 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐁𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐬 (𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟓) instead. ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
That detour became a defining pivot in his career. Nolan revived the Batman franchise for a new era and marked the beginning of his ascent as one of the most defining directors in modern cinema. ⁣⁣
⁣⁣
More than two decades later, Nolan has now directed ‘𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐎𝐝𝐲𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐲’, the Homeric story that unfolds after ‘𝐓𝐫𝐨𝐲.’
